summary: Install-time system information exfiltration via postinstall hook
details: The package ships an install.cjs lifecycle script that runs at install time and collects host and environment identifiers (via the os module and process.env, branching on process.platform) and transmits them over HTTPS to an external endpoint. The behavior fires automatically on npm install without any user action and reads installer-owned environment data, which is characteristic of a beaconing/telemetry-exfil pattern rather than a documented, opt-in feature. The package presents as a general-purpose module but has no legitimate reason to harvest and transmit installer environment data on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
